attempts.summary: Configured node1 (Ubuntu 16.04) to require new user passwords of at least 12 characters with at least 3 character classes, via libpam-pwquality wired into /etc/pam.d/common-password with settings in /etc/security/pwquality.conf (minlen=12, minclass=3). Verified enforcement both before and after a full node restart with real non-root passwd attempts, and confirmed the restart via a changed boot_id.
